articles.title: Congress waiting like 'political vulture' to exploit West Asia war: PM Modi
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi strongly attacked the Congress party, accusing them of behaving like "political vultures" and exploiting the West Asia war situation for political opportunism. Modi's sharp criticism highlights a significant domestic political debate concerning parties' conduct and responsibilities in responding to international crises, emphasizing the government's stance against perceived partisan exploitation of sensitive global events.

articles.title: Defence Ministry signs ₹1,950 crore deal with BEL for mountain radars
articles.summary: The Ministry of Defence has signed a significant capital acquisition contract with state-owned Bharat Electronics Limited (BEL). This agreement aims to bolster India's border detection and surveillance capabilities. The initiative underscores the government's focus on modernizing defence infrastructure and strengthening national security through advanced indigenous technology, enhancing India's overall defence preparedness.

articles.title: UPSC Quiz – 2026 : IASbaba’s Daily Current Affairs Quiz 28th March 2026
articles.summary: Exercise Suryakiran is an annual bilateral joint military exercise conducted between the Indian Army and the Nepal Army. This vital collaboration enhances defence cooperation and interoperability, fostering regional security and mutual understanding. The upcoming 19th edition, Suryakiran XIX 2025, continues this significant tradition of joint training and strategic coordination, crucial for aspirants to understand India's military diplomacy.

articles.title: GRSE posts record Rs 6,400 crore turnover, delivers eight vessels to Indian Navy
articles.summary: Garden Reach Shipbuilders & Engineers Limited (GRSE) achieved its largest-ever provisional annual turnover of Rs 6,400 crore in FY26, a significant increase from Rs 5,076 crore in FY25. This record-breaking financial performance by the Kolkata-based defence public sector undertaking underscores India's growing indigenous shipbuilding capabilities and its stride towards 'Atmanirbhar Bharat' in defence manufacturing, bolstering national security and economic self-reliance.

articles.title: More A-10s Are Headed to the Middle East
articles.summary: U.S. Air Force A-10C Thunderbolt II jets are actively supporting Operation Epic Fury in Iran. These attack aircraft have been targeting fast attack watercraft, particularly in the critical Strait region. This operation highlights ongoing U.S. military presence and strategic interests in the Middle East, focusing on maritime security and regional stability challenges.

articles.title: Tejas Networks completes delivery of 17,000 IP/MPLS routers for BharatNet Phase III
articles.summary: Tejas Networks, an Indian company based in Bengaluru, announced a significant milestone, having cumulatively shipped over 17,000 units of its IP/MP… products. This achievement underscores the company's robust growth and its contribution to the telecommunications and networking sector. The firm, listed on BSE and NSE, continues to be a key player in providing advanced networking solutions, marking a notable technological advancement domestically.

articles.title: Finnish PM on stray drones: "War is coming closer to us"
articles.summary: Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo reassured citizens after two armed drones inadvertently entered southeastern Finland on Sunday. While investigations continue, the PM indicated there was no immediate sign of hostile intent from the drones. This incident involving airspace violation by military-style equipment underscores the complexities of border security and required a national leader's prompt address to maintain public calm.

articles.title: CBSE Board Exams: ‘Schools must refrain from collecting unauthorised fees for second exam’
articles.summary: CBSE has issued a circular to affiliated schools regarding the submission of the List of Candidates (LOC) for the Class 10 second board examination. This directive aims to streamline the registration process for students appearing in the upcoming supplementary exams. Aspirants should note such organizational updates as they reflect national education policy and administrative efficiency.
